product.title: Lil Bit Of Everything Subscription x2 (20gx8)
product.body_html:
One of each of our unique monthly subscription coffees, including our favorite print. Clean coffees will be rated .5/5 or less on the funk scale, and funky coffees will be at least a 1.5/5. 

Each order after the first of the Some of Everything subscription will be discounted by $8 and will include a unique print (up to three prints maximum). E.g. ordering 3 Some of Everything subs will cost $44 ($20 + $12 + $12) and get you three tubes of each coffee, ~60g of each coffee. 

Purchasing any CETO subscription will entitle you to a $5 off discount code on any addon orders (stacks with other promotions). Shipping for addon coffees will be bundled with the subscription fulfillment.

Shipping is free within the US.
